placements.title: Placeholder content occupying the role of settled document text
placements.frame: How does minimal, evidently placeholder content present itself as real, current, settled text without hedging or qualification?
placements.why: Both segments are bare placeholder content — a title string explicitly marked as one that 'Should Not Win' and a body of just 'Body.' — yet delivered as present-tense, concrete, unhedged assertions. The thematic subject is the tension between their evidently placeholder nature and their performed settlement as real document content, a subject future envelopes testing document-review or title-selection criteria would continue to feed.
